findings.title: SBC Medical Group notice on unauthorized access and personal information leakage (first report)
findings.summary_md: SBC Medical Group's first Japanese notice reported unauthorized access to databases managed by its Japanese subsidiary, discovered on November 16, with basic data for 1,624,000 customers from 2010 through 2023 plus separate reservation, inquiry, treatment-monitor and review categories. It said the system was hit by 770,000 consecutive attacks from overseas overnight, that passwords from that period were stored unencrypted, and that the database incident was reported to Japan's Personal Information Protection Commission on November 16. The company said the intrusion method and route remained under investigation and that it had not confirmed acquisition of electronic medical records or data from the mySBC reservation site.

findings.title: SBC Medical Group Reports Cybersecurity Incidents in Japan
findings.summary_md: SBC Medical Group's English investor release described the November 16 database intrusion and a separate compromise of clinic administrator accounts on Tribeau, a booking service used by 56 clinics. It listed basic data for 1,624,000 people, reservation requests for 255,416, web inquiries for 217,769, treatment-monitor records for 4,513, reviews for 15,007 and expired or otherwise unprocessable card data for 14, plus about 20,000 employee account records and bank or pension details for 459 employees. SBC said it isolated the affected server, preserved system logs, tightened access restrictions, invalidated Tribeau clinic passwords and blocked communications from the attacking sources.

findings.title: Tribeau notice on unauthorized access to its clinic management application
findings.summary_md: Tribeau said monitoring detected suspected unauthorized logins on November 16 into the clinic management application supplied to Shonan Beauty Clinic and Ritz Beauty Surgery Tokyo, and it disabled the affected accounts that day. It reported reservation data for 12,641 people, message content plus date of birth and sex for three of them, and treatment name, date and fee for 6,804 people. The operator said it blocked attacker communications, had not confirmed external publication or misuse of the data, and confirmed the stolen records were not linked to case or review information including photographs.

findings.title: SBC Medical Group Holdings Inc 8-K exhibit 99.1
findings.summary_md: SBC Medical Group filed the two-incident disclosure as Exhibit 99.1 to a Form 8-K under items 8.01 and 9.01, with EDGAR acceptance recorded as 2026-11-18 21:53:32. The exhibit repeats the affected-category counts and states that the company had not confirmed unauthorized acquisition of electronic medical records or information in the mySBC reservation site. It also says SBC expected costs for customer notification, call center operations, forensic investigation, legal and advisory services and compensation, but could not reasonably estimate the financial impact.

findings.title: Shonan Beauty Clinic and other SBC Medical Group clinics leak personal data of 1,624,000 people in cyberattack
findings.summary_md: Security Measures Lab reported the 1,624,000-person basic data category and the separate Tribeau exposure, noting that the categories can overlap and cannot be added into a unique victim total. It cited SBC's account of about 770,000 attacks from overseas, log analysis showing customer data leaving on November 16 and isolation of the affected server that morning. The article flagged cleartext passwords and the risk of phishing that uses real reservation, treatment and fee details, while noting that no secondary abuse had been confirmed in the first report.
